tasks.descripcion: Para los pipes de comunicación, pudiendo crear rooms y foros indexados con creación de wiki continua además del CHANGELOG.md
tasks.acceptance_criteria:
Basándome en la configuración existente del repo (servicios `matrix-postgres`, `matrix-synapse`, `Dockerfile.matrix`, `.config/matrix/homeserver.yaml` y `scripts/matrix-entrypoint.sh`), aquí tienes un stack **standalone** extraído y adaptado para ZimaBoard 2 (Intel N100, x86_64, sin GPU):

---

## Estructura de ficheros

```
matrix-zimaboard/
├── docker-compose.yml
├── .env
├── secrets/
│   ├── matrix_db_password.txt
│   └── redis_password.txt
├── config/
│   └── homeserver.yaml
├── scripts/
│   └── matrix-entrypoint.sh
└── data/
    ├── matrix-postgres/
    ├── matrix-synapse/
    └── redis/
```

---

## `docker-compose.yml`

Basado en los servicios `matrix-postgres` y `matrix-synapse` del compose principal: [1](#0-0) 

```yaml
# ============================================================
# Matrix Stack para ZimaBoard 2 (Intel N100, x86_64)
# Servicios: Synapse + PostgreSQL + Redis + Element Web
# ============================================================

volumes:
  matrix_data:
  matrix_postgres_data:
  redis_data:

networks:
  matrix_net:
    driver: bridge
    ipam:
      config:
        - subnet: 172.30.0.0/24

secrets:
  matrix_db_password:
    file: ./secrets/matrix_db_password.txt
  redis_password:
    file: ./secrets/redis_password.txt

services:

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # PostgreSQL dedicado para Synapse
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  matrix-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    hostname: matrix-postgres
    container_name: matrix-postgres
    networks:
      - matrix_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    secrets:
      - matrix_db_password
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: matrix_user
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/matrix_db_password
      POSTGRES_DB: matrix_synapse
      # Synapse requiere UTF8 + locale C
      POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS: "--encoding=UTF8 --locale=C --auth-host=scram-sha-256"
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    command:
      - "postgres"
      - "-c"
      - "max_connections=100"
      - "-c"
      - "shared_buffers=128MB"
    volumes:
      - ./data/matrix-postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U matrix_user -d matrix_synapse"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - SETUID
      - SETGID
      - DAC_OVERRIDE
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '1.0'
          memory: 512M
        reservations:
          memory: 128M
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "10m"
        max-file: "3"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # Redis — cache de sesiones y presencia
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  redis:
    image: redis:7.2-alpine
    hostname: redis
    container_name: matrix-redis
    networks:
      - matrix_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    secrets:
      - redis_password
    # Lee la contraseña del secret y arranca con requirepass
    command: >
      sh -c "redis-server --requirepass $$(cat /run/secrets/redis_password)
             --maxmemory 128mb
             --maxmemory-policy allkeys-lru"
    volumes:
      - redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - "CMD-SHELL"
        - "redis-cli -a $$(cat /run/secrets/redis_password) ping | grep PONG"
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '0.5'
          memory: 256M
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "5m"
        max-file: "3"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # Matrix Synapse — homeserver
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  matrix-synapse:
    image: matrixdotorg/synapse:v1.104.0
    hostname: matrix
    container_name: matrix-synapse
    networks:
      - matrix_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      # Acceso desde la LAN del ZimaBoard
      - "8008:8008"   # Client API + Federation
      - "8448:8448"   # Federation (puerto estándar)
    secrets:
      - matrix_db_password
      - redis_password
    environment:
      SYNAPSE_SERVER_NAME: "${MATRIX_SERVER_NAME:-matrix.local}"
      SYNAPSE_REPORT_STATS: "no"
      # Usados por el entrypoint para sustituir en homeserver.yaml
      POSTGRES_HOST: matrix-postgres
      POSTGRES_PORT: "5432"
      POSTGRES_DB: matrix_synapse
      POSTGRES_USER: matrix_user
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      REDIS_DBID: "0"
      ENABLE_REGISTRATION: "${ENABLE_REGISTRATION:-true}"
    volumes:
      - matrix_data:/data
      - ./config/homeserver.yaml:/data/homeserver.yaml:ro
      - ./scripts/matrix-entrypoint.sh:/usr/local/bin/matrix-entrypoint.sh:ro
      - ./data/matrix-synapse/logs:/data/logs
      - ./data/matrix-synapse/media:/data/media_store
    entrypoint: ["/usr/local/bin/matrix-entrypoint.sh"]
    depends_on:
      matrix-postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "curl -fsSL http://localhost:8008/health || exit 1"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 90s
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    cap_add:
      - CHOWN
      - SETUID
      - SETGID
      - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          # N100 tiene 4 cores — dejamos 2 para el resto del sistema
          cpus: '2.0'
          memory: 1G
        reservations:
          memory: 256M
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "20m"
        max-file: "5"

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  # Element Web — cliente Matrix en el navegador
  # Acceso: http://<IP-ZIMABOARD>:8080
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────
  element-web:
    image: vectorim/element-web:latest
    hostname: element-web
    container_name: element-web
    networks:
      - matrix_net
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    volumes:
      - ./config/element-config.json:/app/config.json:ro
    depends_on:
      matrix-synapse:
        condition: service_healthy
    deploy:
      resources:
        limits:
          cpus: '0.5'
          memory: 128M
    logging:
      driver: "json-file"
      options:
        max-size: "5m"
        max-file: "3"
```

  - port: 8008

    type: http

    bind_addresses: ['0.0.0.0']

  - port: 8448

Basado en el script existente del repo: [3](#0-2) 

```bash
#!/bin/sh
set -e

CONFIG_FILE=/data/homeserver.yaml

echo "==> Inyectando secretos en homeserver.yaml..."

# Copiar la config (es read-only) a un temporal editable
cp /data/homeserver.yaml /tmp/homeserver.yaml

if [ -f /run/secrets/matrix_db_password ]; then
  DB_PASSWORD=$(cat /run/secrets/matrix_db_password)
  sed -i "s/REPLACE_WITH_DB_SECRET/${DB_PASSWORD}/g" /tmp/homeserver.yaml
else
  echo "ERROR: Secret matrix_db_password no encontrado"
  exit 1
fi

if [ -f /run/secrets/redis_password ]; then
  REDIS_PASSWORD=$(cat /run/secrets/redis_password)
  sed -i "s/REPLACE_WITH_REDIS_SECRET/${REDIS_PASSWORD}/g" /tmp/homeserver.yaml
else
  echo "ERROR: Secret redis_password no encontrado"
  exit 1
fi

# Generar signing key si no existe
if [ ! -f /data/matrix.local.signing.key ]; then
  echo "==> Generando signing key..."
  python3 -m synapse.app.homeserver \
    --server-name="matrix.local" \
    --config-path=/tmp/homeserver.yaml \
    --generate-keys
fi

# Generar log config si no existe
if [ ! -f /data/logs/homeserver.log.config ]; then
  mkdir -p /data/logs
  cat > /data/logs/homeserver.log.config << 'EOF'
version: 1
formatters:
  precise:
    format: '%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(lineno)d - %(levelname)s - %(message)s'
handlers:
  file:
    class: logging.handlers.RotatingFileHandler
    formatter: precise
    filename: /data/logs/homeserver.log
    maxBytes: 52428800
    backupCount: 3
    encoding: utf8
  console:
    class: logging.StreamHandler
    formatter: precise
loggers:
  synapse.storage.SQL:
    level: WARNING
root:
  level: INFO
  handlers: [file, console]
disable_existing_loggers: false
EOF
fi

echo "==> Arrancando Matrix Synapse..."
exec python3 -m synapse.app.homeserver \
  --server-name="matrix.local" \
  --config-path=/tmp/homeserver.yaml
```
